product.title: Ruby's Horseback Adventures Utah Half Day Ride

description.text: Ride a beginner-friendly half-day horseback outing through Utah's scenic Red Canyon near Bryce Canyon National Park. Follow a guide along rugged trails past Native American ruins and through the red rock canyon. Stops include Red Canyon. With more than 6 miles to cover, this tour is a practical way to experience Red Canyon on horseback. Ideal for visitors basing near Bryce Canyon City who want a guided red-rock experience without coordinating park entrances, trailheads, or photo stops on their own.
